texts.preamble: Brajesh Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 February, 2021 Author: Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava Bench: Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava 1 Mcrc-10074-2021 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Mcrc-10074-2021 (Brajesh Rathore Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Gwalior, Dated : 26-02-2021
texts.arguments: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that by order dated 22/10/2019 passed in MCRC No. 43317/2019, the petitioner was granted regular bail under Section 439 of CrPC under certain conditions in which condition No. 7 was that "applicant shall mark his presence before concerned trial court once every Fortnight till conclusion of trial.". It is further submitted that the petitioner is regularly appearing before the trial Court but since petitioner is a businessman, therefore, ofttently he has to go out from his native place and, therefore, he is facing difficulty in appearing before the trial Court in every 15 days. Hence, prayed for exemption from compliance of condition No. 7 or modification to the same. Per contra, learned State counsel has opposed the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner and prayed to reject the petition.
